song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Thus — dense self-consciousness, one alone: He is Śiva, the universe’s supreme light.
And there too, in variegated power, shines the split of grasped and grasper.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svasaṃvidghana eka eva śivaḥ sa viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ | tatrāpi bhātyeva vicitraśaktau grāhyagṛhītṛpravibhāgabhedaḥ

verses.craft: Positive declaration after denial; ittham unforced (UNC: back-link or new movement — kept open); grasped-grasper split shines.
verses.rejected: (a) forcing ittham-link → killed by UNC. (b) variegated→manifold → killed: L3 frozen.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
